notifications.danger: The product is supplied with a plug that has no facility for a fuse. Moreover, it is supplied with a travel adaptor that is unsuitable for charging motorbikes. notifications.name: Dance Factory
notifications.danger: The solders in the product have an excessive concentration of lead and cadmium (measured value up to 75.1% and 0.3% by weight, respectively). The plastic material of the cable has excessive concentrations of bis(2-ethylhexyl) phthalate (DEHP), di-n-butyl phthalate (DBP) and short chain chlorinated paraffins (SCCPs) (measured value up to 1.36%, 0.43% and 4.98% by weight, respectively). DEHP and DBP pose a risk to human health and the environment. SCCPs persist in the environment, are toxic to aquatic organisms at low concentrations and bio-accumulate in wildlife and humans, posing a risk to human health and the environment. Prolonged exposure to them through the skin may cause cancer. The product does not comply with the requirements of the Directive on the restriction of the use of certain hazardous substances in electrical and electronic equipment (RoHS 2 Directive) nor with the Persistent Organic Pollutants (POP) Regulation.
